versions.changelog:
Initial release of the skill for managing client records.

- Handles full lifecycle of client records, including creation, renaming, merging, archiving, validation, and updates.
- Sole owner of `clients.json` and all client folders; all mutations must go through this skill.
- Systematically invoked on any user request to act on a client record (create, update, rename, archive, etc.).
- Distinguishes explicit user actions from auto-created drafts by `organisation-documents`.
- Executes all operations inline with clear, concise communication tailored for accounting workflows.
